description:
Browser automation solution with CLI memory layer for high-speed, stable browser access.
Usage examples: 
To download a video, send "/websculpt-explore Use my browser to download this video for me." 
If the command stops working due to a website redesign, send "/websculpt-maintain The YouTube video
